name: Chandragupta Maurya
contribution: The founder and the first emperor of the Maurya Empire, based in Magadha in the Indian subcontinent.
legacy: He started a war against the unpopular Nanda dynasty in Magadha on the Ganges Valley, defeated them and established his own dynasty.

checks.lead: Chandragupta Maurya (reigned c. 320 BCE – c. 298 BCE) was the founder and the first emperor of the Maurya Empire, based in Magadha (present-day Bihar) in the Indian subcontinent.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
